claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 18350 800mAh 12A as a 800mAh preset with a 12A runtime rating.
The AW IMR 18350 800mAh entry is listed as an unprotected button-top cell in an aggregated battery test database.

The AW IMR 18350 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for AW IMR 18350 in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
